messages:
maria_sales: Hi team — EvansCorp sent their security questionnaire and wants to run a 2-week POC in their AWS account. They asked: PrivateLink vs VPC peering recommendation, if we require a bastion for installer, minimal firewall rules, and any line-item for endpoint costs for the SOW. Can we send a short technical blurb?

ajay_neteng: Quick guidance: prefer Interface VPC Endpoint (PrivateLink) when the workload is deployed into a single customer account and you need explicit cross-account boundaries. VPC peering works for low-latency internal VPCs in same region but lacks cross-account endpoint policies.

maria_sales: They also asked about DNS: do we need conditional forwarding or will the endpoint FQDN resolve automatically?

ajay_neteng: PrivateLink: endpoint will get an AWS-assigned DNS name. Recommend they enable private DNS for the endpoint so our service domain resolves to the ENI IPs. If they use peering, they must manage route table + shared DNS (Route53 Resolver or conditional forwarder).

liz_security: From the questionnaire: they require no inbound internet access to service subnets and must capture flow logs. Send them this minimal allowlist snippet.

liz_security: ```
# Minimal allowlist for Private Deploy (example)
- Outbound TCP 443 to: 34.198.12.0/24, 52.23.89.0/24 (control plane)
- If PrivateLink: create Interface Endpoint to com.redwood.inference; add endpoint policy limiting to account <account-id>
- Block inbound 0.0.0.0/0 to service subnets; only allow management CIDRs for SSM or jumpbox
- Enable VPC Flow Logs -> their SIEM/S3/Kinesis for 90d retention
```

tom_deploy: Installer note: we can use our unattended installer over HTTPS; no permanent bastion required. Preferred: SSM Session Manager for ephemeral access. If customer doesn't allow SSM, a short-lived bastion with strict security group + MACsec is OK.

maria_sales: Good. Any pricing specifics for the SOW? They asked whether PrivateLink will increase recurring costs.

rachel_ae: Line items to include: one-time onboarding fee, hourly PrivateLink endpoint charges (AWS-managed, usually ~$0.01-$0.02/hr depending on region), data processing tier (per-GB), and our reserved/dedicated capacity fee if they opt for dedicated GPUs. We should add a coarse estimate in USD for the 2-week POC.

ajay_neteng: Note on ports: only 443 outbound for API/control and ephemeral ports for health checks if they use internal load balancer (we'll provide specifics). Avoid 22 unless they request SSH; prefer SSM.

liz_security: Add this QA to the questionnaire answers: "We do not require TLS termination by customer. If customer terminates and inspects TLS, ensure SNI passthrough or consider PrivateLink with TLS between our service and customer ENI."

infra_bot: Template available: templates/privatedeploy/aws/quickstart_v1.yaml — run `./deploy.sh --account <acct> --region <region>` after cross-account role is created.

maria_sales: Action items: 1) I'll request account ID + VPC CIDRs + preferred region. 2) Ask security contact if SSM is allowed. 3) Send the allowlist snippet + rough cost estimate for PrivateLink endpoint + data processing.

liz_security: Also ask for retention window on logs and whether they require HSM/KMS integration for keys used by the deployment.

tom_deploy: For the POC SOW I'll include: network diagram (PrivateLink + peering options), firewall allowlist snippet, installer path (SSM vs bastion), and estimated infra costs.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll follow up with EvansCorp and paste their answers here when I have them. :thumbsup:
